name: bash-wizardry-video
description: Product explainer film for bash-wizardry, built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run gen && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:en: npm run gen && remotion render src/index.ts BashWizardry-en out/bash-wizardry-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:es: npm run gen && remotion render src/index.ts BashWizardry-es out/bash-wizardry-es.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.still: npm run gen && remotion still src/index.ts BashWizardry-en out/still.png
